title: How-to
weight: 2
sidebar:
  open: true
---

Recipes for one task each, with the cmdlets and, where they differ, the methods side by side. New to the module: start with the [tutorials](../tutorials/).

- [Choose an adapter](how-to-choose-an-adapter/) - the GPU with the features a script needs, opened as the default, or the software adapter.
- [Run a compute shader](how-to-run-a-compute-shader/) - a histogram of a large array, counted on the GPU with atomics.
- [Map and reduce arrays](how-to-map-and-reduce-arrays/) - readings cleaned up and standardized by expressions, with no shader.
- [Work with buffers](how-to-work-with-buffers/) - heat along a rod, many steps with the data kept on the GPU.
- [Run GLSL and SPIR-V shaders](how-to-run-glsl-and-spir-v-shaders/) - shaders written for Vulkan or OpenGL, run as they are.
- [Check and translate shaders](how-to-check-and-translate-shaders/) - a project's shaders checked, listed and translated, with no GPU.
- [Use an existing image](how-to-use-an-existing-image/) - a picture from disk through a compute shader and onto a shape.
- [Work with textures and images](how-to-work-with-textures-and-images/) - floor tiles made on the GPU, their mip levels and layers, and three samplers.
- [Edit and adjust images](how-to-edit-and-adjust-images/) - crop, scale, frame, turn, colors, filters, cutouts and HDR.
- [Pack channels into one texture](how-to-pack-channels-into-one-texture/) - a material's masks in the channels of one texture.
- [Prepare textures for a renderer](how-to-prepare-textures-for-a-renderer/) - mip levels, clean edges, normal maps and block compression, in KTX2 and DDS files.
- [Render offscreen](how-to-render-offscreen/) - charts of data drawn into image files.
- [Light a scene with an environment](how-to-light-a-scene-with-an-environment/) - spheres lit by an HDR sky and a studio through cube maps and a BRDF table.
- [Draw in a render pass of your own](how-to-draw-in-a-render-pass-of-your-own/) - several draws, viewports and scissors in one pass.
- [Record commands by hand](how-to-record-commands-by-hand/) - 64 generations of the Game of Life in one submission.
- [Time and count GPU work](how-to-time-and-count-gpu-work/) - how long a shader takes on the GPU, and what a pass did.
- [Wait without blocking](how-to-wait-without-blocking/) - tasks, progress, deadlines and failed jobs.
- [Use threads and runspaces](how-to-use-threads-and-runspaces/) - thumbnails made in parallel on one GPU.
- [Handle errors](how-to-handle-errors/) - a script that copes when GPU work fails.
- [Debug GPU work](how-to-debug-gpu-work/) - names in wgpu's messages, captures, errors outside any call, and memory.
- [Use the Rust library](how-to-use-the-rust-library/) - the library the cmdlets run on, from a Rust program.
